correctness.rationale: Outside a null set the no-carry inequalities are exactly strict upper-record inequalities. In a cell just below r/d, if r/d is not reduced then j=d/gcd(r,d)<d beats the candidate. If reduced, the Farey predecessor a/b has rb−da=1. Just left of r/d the dth point is higher than all earlier points, with no ordering change in the Farey interval. To its left within the same cell, bε>1/d and bε<1 for ε=r/d−x, so {bx}=1+1/d−bε>{dx}. The inverse-residue map permutes the units and yields the stated per-index probability. Linearity needs no independence. The expected count is the positive off-diagonal coprime reciprocal sum on one triangle, giving (1) via Möbius inversion (including the empty sum at N=1). Uniform harmonic errors O(k/N) contribute O((log N)^2/N); the centered tail k>N of k^{-2}(1+log²(k/N)) is O(1/N). Absolute convergence justifies the first two derivatives of 1/ζ and gives the signs and constant in (2). Independent replay python /workspace/branches/independent_frozen_checks.py 3 checks exact floor-cell means through N=21 and the three numerical coefficients; it does not substitute for the all-N argument. This is a mean, not a typical-phase growth law.
